outline_shape.value: Six shallow, smoothly joined cloud lobes around a near-circular compact body, following the handheld reference uploaded 2026-11-12; avoid pronounced deep valleys.

layout.value: square colour screen centred above three round buttons, lanyard nub on top, as reference image 1

display.value: 优信电子 1.3寸TFT彩屏模块(带铁框)_7P焊接；ST7789，240x240 IPS，3.3V，无按键

buttons.value: 3 tactile switches 6x6 mm with printed domed caps; centre one larger

charging.value: USB-C on the XIAO, reachable through the shell side

design_direction.value: Compact translucent lavender-blue cloud pebble with smooth shallow scallops, a moderately sized dark circular screen bezel around the square display, broad curved side slopes, three lower domed buttons with a larger middle button, and a small top lanyard ball.

custom_pcb.value: Custom PCB requested for pet device

key_pcb_implementation.value: One 66x60x1.0mm 2-layer FR4 mixed production panel contains one52.5x45.5mm carrier and one20x11mm screen adapter. Finished piece outlines, switch axes, USB/XIAO position and connector directions retained. Common1.0mm thickness requires carrier underside supports+0.6mm and adapter underside supports-0.2mm while mating/component top faces stay fixed; CAD adaptation must be checked before printing.

display_grove_on_pcb.value: Replace the Grove display connector with a 7-pin plug-in cable connector on pet-keys, for the selected YouXin 1.3-inch TFT; adapt PCB and enclosure.

charging_opening_appearance.value: Approved recessed rounded USB-C opening with same-colour inner surround; preserve opening and XIAO location during PCB adaptation.

button_group_spacing.value: Place the left and right front buttons at the green marked lower-inner positions in mark 1; keep the middle button at its current position.

xiao_direct_plug.value: XIAO ESP32-S3 plugs directly into pet-keys via two 7-position 2.54 mm rows; verify enclosure fit.

display_interface.value: 7-pin 2.54 mm SPI: GND,VCC,SCL,SDA,RES,DC,BLK; no CS. SCL is SPI clock and SDA is MOSI. BLK low disables backlight; default floating state enabled. Seller drawings in uploaded 20261110T152829794Z images.

display_cable.value: JST GH1.25mm7P positive-lock precrimped150mm cable, GHR-07V-S housings and SSHL-002T-P0.2 contacts both ends,pin1-to-pin1. Not SH/ZH/PicoBlade. Screen exposed square pin tips shortened to2.5mm for3mm socket cavity; no desoldering.

thin_body.value: 整个机器不要这么厚；保留已选彩屏和云朵造型，压缩内部接插件堆叠。

firm_assembly.value: 整机不要松垮：屏幕、载板和插接件牢固固定，避免晃动和异响；按键可正常回弹。

shell_finish.value: 前壳、后壳及一体挂绳球均为半透明外壳。

front_proportions.value: 外缘更加圆滑，六瓣之间没有明显深凹；正面紫色区域更窄、整体更紧凑，按2026-11-12用户参考图调整。

side_edge_profile.value: 按2026-11-12侧视绿线标记，边缘改为更大范围、更大坡度的连续圆滑收边，减少中段直立壁面。

middle_button_larger.value: 放大正面中间按钮，保留中间键中心位置。

bezel_size_preference.value: 黑色圆形屏框小一点；按用户指定的bezel部件调整。

pcb_panel_manufacturing.value: 主载板和屏幕转接板混拼在同一张生产板上加工，分板后装配。
